title: SeedZ Management Trainee - E-Commerce

questions: The posting asks for TOEIC 750 or IELTS 6.5. Do you have a recent score?

reasons.love: Commercial rotation in FMCG / e-commerce, one of his preferred tracks.
reasons.good_at: F20 and F25 show leadership and communication in a student-run company; F26 shows Excel reporting.
reasons.needs: Established company with formal training for graduates.
reasons.paid: Estimate: the posting states no salary. THB 50,000-65,000 per month. for a comparable Bangkok graduate role.

summary: Strong fit on role and growth; confirm the open questions before applying.
jd_text: L'Oréal Thailand is hiring for SeedZ Management Trainee - E-Commerce in Bangkok, Thailand. You will work with cross-functional teams, analyse sales and customer data, prepare weekly reports and present recommendations to managers. Requirements: bachelor's degree in any field (2026-2027 graduates welcome); good command of English and Thai; strong Excel; a team player who learns quickly. We offer structured training, mentoring and a clear career path.
